passage.title: Model paragraph written for TGA
paras: Shakespeare presents ambition as a force that silences conscience. [Point] Asking the stars to hide his 'black and deep desires', [Evidence] Macbeth uses light and dark imagery [Technique] in which 'deep' suggests desires buried inside him long before the witches spoke. [Zoom in] He knows they are evil, yet he chooses them. [Analyse] Arguably, the witches plant the idea; however, Banquo hears the same prophecy and does not kill. [Alternative] For a Jacobean audience, this choice of regicide would be the deepest sin, so Shakespeare warns that ambition must answer to conscience. [Link]
